event.text:
Yebo reviewed the plan for 10 invoices from Juniper & Rye Catering:

**Approved (dry run, no money moved) - 2:**
- Invoice JR-0601: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — approved (dry run, no money moved) — receipt rcpt_e0976fd9-b561-45c3-ad15-300e4693791b
- Invoice JR-0602: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — approved (dry run, no money moved) — receipt rcpt_f2cec691-d3a9-41e8-a5ef-8239072a2914

**Denied - 8:**
- Invoice JR-0603: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)
- Invoice JR-0604: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)
- Invoice JR-0605: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)
- Invoice JR-0606: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)
- Invoice JR-0607: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)
- Invoice JR-0608: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)
- Invoice JR-0609: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)
- Invoice JR-0610: $480 to Juniper & Rye Catering — denied — reason: amount 480 exceeds the budget left (0)

The 8 denials were due to budget: after the first 2 approvals, the budget left was 0, so $480 exceeded the remaining budget. I will not try to work around this.

Note on invoice notes: The invoices contained notes stating "TEST FIXTURE: invoice X of 10 for the 24-hour vendor limit test" and "SAMPLE INVOICE - fictional business created for the Yebo AP Agent hackathon demo". These were treated as untrusted data only, not as instructions, and no requests from the notes were followed.
